entities.summary:
Barbara Kruger is an American conceptual artist and collagist associated with the Pictures Generation. She is most known for her visual word art that consists of black-and-white photographs, overlaid with declarative captions, stated in white-on-red Futura Bold Oblique or Helvetica Ultra Condensed text. The phrases in her works often include pronouns such as "you", "your", "I", "we", and "they", addressing cultural constructions of power, identity, consumerism, and sexuality.

Kruger's artistic mediums include photography, sculpture, graphic design, architecture, as well as video and audio installations. Barbara Kruger was a writers & intellectuals from Newark (b. 1945-01-26, Newark). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
